restart.name: [%key:common::action::restart%]
restart.description: Restart a container, the container must be configured in monitor_docker.

server.description: Name of the server, as given in config. Only required if you have more than one docker host config.
server.name: Server

user.description: Set up a connection to a Docker host

docker_connection.description: Connect directly to a Docker daemon (local socket, or remote over TCP)

data.url: Host URL of Docker daemon. Leave empty to auto-detect a local socket. For a remote daemon use e.g. tcp://ip:2375, or ssh://user@host
data.version: Docker API version (leave as 'auto' unless you need to pin a specific version)
data.certpath: If a TCP socket is used, you can define your Docker certificate path, forcing Monitor Docker to enable TLS. The filenames must be cert.pem and key.pem

portainer_connection.description: Connect through a Portainer Docker-proxy endpoint instead of a Docker daemon directly. Get the API key from Portainer under My account > API tokens, and the endpoint id from the URL when viewing that environment in Portainer.

data.portainer_https: Portainer uses HTTPS (self-signed certificates are accepted automatically)

data.containers: Array of containers to monitor (keep empty to add all, and new)
data.containers_exclude: Array of containers to be excluded from monitoring, when all containers are included

containers_rename.description: Select a display name for each container

data.rename_entity: If rename is done, it changes also the entity name

conditions.description: Setup a connection to docker host

data.monitored_docker_conditions: Conditions of the controller to be monitored
data.monitored_container_conditions: Conditions of each container to be monitored
data.switchenabled: Enable/Disable the switch entity for containers
data.buttonenabled: Enable/Disable the button entity for containers
data.memorychange: Change of memory usage before alerting
data.precision_disk_mb: Precision of disk read/write in MB
data.precision_memory_mb: Precision of memory usage in MB
data.precision_memory_percentage: Precision of memory usage in percentage
data.precision_network_kb: Precision of network bandwidth in kB
data.precision_network_mb: Precision of network usage in MB

remove_configuration_yaml.description:
Fist ensure that your integration settings from configuration.yaml still are intact (renaming is no longer available). Explicit settings can be viewed and changed in the Reconfigure meny for each integration istance.
Renaming can be done on device or entiti level in UI.
Then remove your settings for {domain} {integration_title} from configuration.yaml to get rid of this message.
remove_configuration_yaml.title: Manually configured {integration_title} no longer used
